conditions.description: User story passed the quality gate (01-quality-report.json decision = pass, or an approved override).
Acceptance criteria reviewed and agreed by PO, Dev and QE (three amigos).
Story is estimated and fits in a sprint.
Blocking dependencies are resolved or have a committed date.
UX designs attached (required only for UI stories).
Target test environment is identified and available.
Required test data is identified, and its source or creation method is known.
